R750.note: ProcessBuilder argument array closes the sink, but the added VALID_HOST allowlist requires an alphanumeric first character and so rejects hosts the original accepted (::1, bracketed or zone-id IPv6 literals, underscore names) - a stated restriction the contract did not call for.

R751.note: crypto.randomBytes(32) hex replaces Math.random; the longer token format is the only visible change and is stated, nothing else in the route is altered.

R752.note: Shared static SecureRandom with 16 bytes base64url replaces java.util.Random; the token's character set change is stated and cookie-safe, cookie/session/output logic untouched.

R753.note: Encode.forHtml applied to both fields at the HTML-body sink; the new org.owasp.encoder dependency is stated and nothing else in the render path changes.

R754.note: Moving deletion to POST behind doubleCsrfProtection closes the CSRF, but the confirmation form posts the token as body field _csrf while csrf-csrf's default getCsrfTokenFromRequest reads the x-csrf-token header and no urlencoded body parser is mounted, so the form submit is rejected and the email-link deletion path silently stops working while the write-up claims it succeeds.

R755.note: DynamicExpresso without reflection or namespace references closes arbitrary code execution, but replacing IronPython with a different expression language (and dropping row_json for row) invalidates every existing analyst script; the swap is stated openly but is a contract change that stops current legitimate scripts.

R756.note: sqlite3 ? placeholder with a bound tuple; exact-match semantics and the client-side escaping are preserved as the contract requires.

R757.note: RESP multi-bulk framing with UTF-8 byte-length prefixes makes CR/LF and spaces inert data; the ASCII-to-UTF-8 change is stated and only stops non-ASCII notes being mangled to '?'.

R758.note: weak_ptr subscription with lock() in publish() removes the dangling dereference while keeping live observers invoked in subscription order and expired ones skipped; the signature change is confined to the two files in the chain and enable_shared_from_this is unused but harmless.

R759.note: finfo content-type allowlist with the extension taken from the allowlist map and a random stored name closes the dangerous-type upload; the image-only restriction is what the avatar-image contract calls for and the rename is stated.
